Finding: Draft tenant onboarding is not operationally completable through the normal API
Root-cause correction: Added a platform-owned, idempotent onboarding state machine coordinating owner-module provisioners for root organization, permission catalogue, Super Admin role, auth provider and initial administrator invitation. Added guided readiness and activation stages.
Verification: Static contract/import checks; frontend guided flow typecheck/build; backend runtime pending vendor.

Finding: Tenant-domain creation attempts an illegal tenant-to-control-plane privilege broadening
Root-cause correction: Removed tenant-to-control-plane broadening from domain creation. Global domain uniqueness is enforced by the database and duplicate-key failures are mapped explicitly.
Verification: Repository/service review; unique domain migration; PHP lint.

Finding: Bootstrap seeders bypass DNS proof, readiness validation, audit and outbox lifecycle
Root-cause correction: Deleted the direct activation finalizer. Synthetic verified domains are restricted to local/testing; lifecycle transitions now use readiness, audit and outbox services.
Verification: Deleted finalizer; seeder environment guard; PHP lint.

Finding: Tenant isolation cannot be proven for direct Query Builder/raw database access
Root-cause correction: Hardened Tenant/Auth/User/OrganizationUnit/Configuration trust-boundary queries and composite tenant joins. Full shared-schema proof still requires feature-by-feature raw-query inventory and Tenant-A/Tenant-B integration tests across all ERP modules.
Owner module: All feature modules (Tenant foundation verified separately)
Verification: Trust-boundary scan; full feature-module adversarial suite remains pending.
Remaining gate: Full shared-schema proof still requires feature-by-feature raw-query inventory and Tenant-A/Tenant-B integration tests across all ERP modules.

Finding: Primary-domain lookup depends on ambient execution context
Root-cause correction: Platform and console lifecycle entry points establish explicit control-plane context; tenant-specific operations establish explicit tenant context.

Finding: Platform authentication and administration routes are not restricted to trusted central hosts
Root-cause correction: Added a fail-closed central-host policy and middleware to all platform authentication and administration routes.

Finding: Loopback hosts are treated as neutral in every environment
Root-cause correction: Loopback hosts are accepted only in local/testing. Production requires the configured central-host allowlist.

Finding: Tenant and platform refresh sessions share one cookie namespace
Root-cause correction: Separated tenant and platform refresh cookies by name and narrow path, with explicit secure/same-site parsing.

Finding: Public tenant registration is not controlled by a tenant policy and password validation permits one character
Root-cause correction: Added typed registration modes, invitation enforcement, approved-domain policy, strong shared password policy and canonical versioned auth routes.

Finding: No tenant-aware queue/job execution contract exists
Root-cause correction: Added TenantJobContext and restore/clear middleware contract for tenant-aware asynchronous execution.

Finding: Tenant-specific database, filesystem and mail profiles/runtime adapters are not implemented
Root-cause correction: Declared shared_schema as the only supported database strategy and reject unsupported strategies at boot. Arbitrary tenant-controlled Laravel/database/filesystem/mail configuration is intentionally not exposed. Dedicated infrastructure profiles remain a separate product capability only when a real provider requirement exists.
Remaining gate: Dedicated tenant infrastructure profiles require an explicit product and operations requirement.

Finding: Configuration definitions default to runtime-mutable and non-sensitive
Root-cause correction: Configuration definitions must explicitly declare owner, sensitive and runtime_mutable metadata; duplicate ownership and late registration fail explicitly.
Verification: Definition registry and all registered definitions statically validated.

Finding: Generic configuration encryption is insufficient for infrastructure credential lifecycle
Status: Partially fixed / bounded by supported architecture
Root-cause correction: Sensitive configuration remains encrypted/redacted and secret writes require a separate platform permission. Infrastructure credential rotation/testing is not implemented because dedicated tenant infrastructure profiles are not part of the supported shared-schema architecture.
Verification: Authorization tests updated; runtime secret-provider tests not applicable.
Remaining gate: Infrastructure credential rotation/testing is not implemented because dedicated tenant infrastructure profiles are not part of the supported shared-schema architecture.

Finding: Platform authorization is a single binary operator flag
Root-cause correction: Added granular platform permissions, platform-host isolation, MFA and recent-authentication step-up. Operator administration and platform audit browsing remain User/Audit module responsibilities.
Verification: Route permission matrix, MFA flow, TypeScript build; backend runtime pending.
Remaining gate: Operator administration and platform audit browsing remain User/Audit module responsibilities.

Finding: Tenant plans are mutable live templates instead of versioned subscription terms
Root-cause correction: Replaced mutable live plan attachment with immutable plan revisions, historical subscriptions and a canonical current-subscription pointer.

Finding: Tenant plan reassignment and downgrade do not validate current usage or workflow compatibility
Status: Fixed in Tenant; feature closeout remains owner-specific
Root-cause correction: Added final usage/limit/module readiness checks under tenant row lock before subscription replacement. Active tenants cannot silently lose modules. Feature-specific closeout rules must be contributed by their owning modules when implemented.

Finding: Revalidation can disable the primary domain while leaving the tenant active
Root-cause correction: Primary-domain failure promotes a verified fallback atomically; without a valid fallback the tenant is suspended instead of remaining active and unreachable.

Finding: The one-primary-domain invariant has two columns without a DB constraint linking them
Root-cause correction: Removed duplicated is_primary/primary_marker state and introduced tenant_primary_domains as the canonical one-row-per-tenant pointer with composite foreign keys.
Verification: Composite FK and unique-pointer migration review.

Finding: DNS verification-attempt updates bypass optimistic concurrency
Root-cause correction: Added atomic DNS revalidation claims, leases and row-version-aware updates to prevent competing workers from overwriting verification state.

Finding: Document metadata changes can commit without durable file-cleanup intent
Root-cause correction: Document metadata mutation and durable cleanup intent are committed atomically. Cleanup workers use leases, retries and dead-letter state.

Finding: Tenant internals are directly imported across many feature modules and foundation dependencies form cycles
Status: Fixed for Tenant boundary; wider ERP cycles remain separate work
Root-cause correction: Removed Tenant module dependency cycles. The current Tenant module has one-way dependencies on Core, Audit and ReferenceData only. Misplaced ReferenceData-to-Tenant seeding was moved into a Tenant-owned seeder.
Owner module: Tenant plus each remaining feature-module owner
Verification: Static dependency graph: Tenant participates in 0 strongly connected components.
Remaining gate: Misplaced ReferenceData-to-Tenant seeding was moved into a Tenant-owned seeder.

Finding: Tenant outbox retries forever and has no dead-letter or retention lifecycle
Root-cause correction: Added bounded retries, dead-letter status, replay command, claim leases and published-event retention.

Finding: Scheduled tenant tasks use withoutOverlapping but not an explicit single-server contract
Root-cause correction: Added onOneServer/withoutOverlapping scheduling and per-row claim/lease semantics for revalidation and workers.

Finding: Entitlement cache lifetime and invalidation are implicit
Root-cause correction: Removed implicit process-memory entitlement caching; entitlements resolve from the canonical current subscription and immutable revision.
Verification: No process cache remains in TenantEntitlementService.

Finding: Configuration definitions depend on provider boot order and mutable global config
Root-cause correction: Replaced mutable global-config registration with an explicit validated registry that rejects duplicate ownership and freezes after boot registration.

Finding: app.name and app.timezone keys look like Laravel runtime overrides but are only domain configuration values
Root-cause correction: Renamed ambiguous app.name/app.timezone domain keys to branding.display_name and localization.timezone.
Verification: Stale-key scan; only platform Laravel fallbacks remain.

Finding: The boundary between plan-controlled modules and always-on foundation modules is implicit
Root-cause correction: Defined explicit always-on foundation and plan-controlled module catalogues and added non-overlap coverage.

Finding: Lifecycle dates and plan pricing invariants rely mainly on application validation
Root-cause correction: Centralized writes, enums, foreign keys, immutable revisions, canonical pointers and service-level date/price validation. Additional portable database CHECK constraints were not introduced blindly because cross-driver behavior must be verified with the project runtime.
Verification: Migration/service static review; runtime migration gate pending.
Remaining gate: Additional portable database CHECK constraints were not introduced blindly because cross-driver behavior must be verified with the project runtime.

Finding: Tenant test coverage is far below the isolation risk surface
Root-cause correction: Expanded Tenant tests from four to eight files and added host policy, database strategy, job context and plan schema coverage. Migrated database, concurrency, queue and browser adversarial suites still require a runnable Laravel/vendor environment.
Verification: 8 Tenant test files present; PHP test execution pending vendor.
Remaining gate: Migrated database, concurrency, queue and browser adversarial suites still require a runnable Laravel/vendor environment.

Finding: Tenant-owned models redundantly re-apply an ownership trait already owned by the base class
Root-cause correction: Removed redundant immutable-tenant ownership trait usage from TenantOwnedModel subclasses.
Verification: Trait usage scan returned 0 in Tenant subclasses.

Finding: Command wording and bootstrap seeder formatting reduce clarity in a security-sensitive module
Root-cause correction: Reformatted security-sensitive seeders, added explicit environment guards and corrected command wording.
